use default

let goal = LIST([
    "UF", "UR", "UB", "UL", "DF", "DR", "DB", "DL", "FR", "FL", "BR", "BL",
    "UFR", "URB", "UBL", "ULF", "DRF", "DFL", "DLB", "DBR"
])

let allowed_moves = [0, 262143, 259263, 74943, 74898]

let faces = [
    [0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1, 2, 3],
    [4, 7, 6, 5, 4, 5, 6, 7],
    [0, 9, 4, 8, 0, 3, 5, 4],
    [2, 10, 6, 11, 2, 1, 7, 6],
    [3, 11, 7, 9, 3, 2, 6, 5],
    [1, 8, 5, 10, 1, 0, 4, 7]
]

let solved =
    (0..40) |> map(i => if i < 20 then i else 0 fi) |> collect_array()

apply(move: int, state: int[]) -> int[] is
    let face = faces[move / 3]
    let turned = LIST[int](state)

    for turn in 0::move % 3 do
        let before = turned.to_array()

        for i in 0..8 do
            let corner = if i > 3 then 12 else 0 fi
            let target = face[i] + corner
            let along = if i & 3 == 3 then i - 3 else i + 1 fi
            let source = face[along] + corner

            let twist =
                if i < 4 then
                    if move / 3 == 2 \/ move / 3 == 3 then 1 else 0 fi
                elif move / 3 < 2 then
                    0
                else
                    2 - (i & 1)
                fi

            turned[target] = before[source]
            turned[target + 20] = before[source + 20] + twist

            if turn == move % 3 then
                turned[target + 20] =
                    turned[target + 20] % (if corner > 0 then 3 else 2 fi)
            fi
        od
    od

    turned.to_array()
si

inverse(move: int) -> int => move + 2 - 2 * (move % 3)

slice(cubie: int) -> int => if cubie > 7 then 2 else cubie & 1 fi

key(phase: int, state: int[]) -> string is
    let values: List[int] =
        if phase == 1 then
            state[20..32]
        elif phase == 2 then
            let edges =
                (0..12)
                    |> map(e => (state[e] / 8) << e)
                    |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a | b)

            LIST[int]([edges | state[31]]) |> cat(state[32..40])
                |> collect_list()
        elif phase == 3 then
            let edges =
                (0..12)
                    |> map(e => slice(state[e]) << 2 * e)
                    |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a | b)

            let corners =
                (0..8)
                    |> map(c => ((state[c + 12] - 12) & 5) << 3 * c)
                    |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a | b)

            let parity =
                (12..20)
                    |> flat_map(i => (i + 1..20) |> map(j => (i, j)))
                    |> filter(p => state[p.`0] > state[p.`1])
                    |> count() % 2

            [edges, corners, parity]
        else
            state
        fi

    values |> join(",")
si

solve_phase(phase: int, start: int[]) -> List[int] is
    let start_key = key(phase, start)
    let goal_key = key(phase, solved)

    let found = LIST[int]()

    if start_key =~ goal_key then
        return found
    fi

    let queue = Collections.Queue[int[]]()
    let direction = MAP[string, int]()
    let last_move = MAP[string, int]()
    let previous = MAP[string, string]()

    queue.enqueue(start)
    queue.enqueue(solved)
    direction[start_key] = 1
    direction[goal_key] = 2

    while true do
        let state = queue.dequeue()
        let state_key = key(phase, state)
        let state_direction = direction[state_key]

        for move in 0..18 do
            if allowed_moves[phase] & (1 << move) == 0 then
                continue
            fi

            let next = apply(move, state)
            let next_key = key(phase, next)
            let seen =
                if direction.contains_key(next_key) then
                    direction[next_key]
                else
                    0
                fi

            if seen == 0 then
                queue.enqueue(next)
                direction[next_key] = state_direction
                last_move[next_key] = move
                previous[next_key] = state_key
            elif seen != state_direction then
                let forward mut = state_key
                let backward mut = next_key
                let joining mut = move

                if state_direction == 2 then
                    forward = next_key
                    backward = state_key
                    joining = inverse(move)
                fi

                found.add(joining)

                while forward !~ start_key do
                    found.insert(0, last_move[forward])
                    forward = previous[forward]
                od

                while backward !~ goal_key do
                    found.add(inverse(last_move[backward]))
                    backward = previous[backward]
                od

                return found
            fi
        od
    od

    found
si

parse(cubies: string) -> int[] is
    let state = LIST[int](solved)

    for (i, cubie) in cubies.split([' ']) |> index() do
        let twisted mut = cubie

        while goal.index_of(twisted) < 0 do
            twisted = "{twisted[1..<0]}{twisted[0]}"
            state[i + 20] = state[i + 20] + 1
        od

        state[i] = goal.index_of(twisted)
    od

    state.to_array()
si

notation(move: int) -> string =>
    "{"UDFBLR"[move / 3]}{["", "2", "'"][move % 3]}"

solve(title: string, start: int[]) is
    let state mut = start
    let moves = LIST[int]()

    for phase in 1::4 do
        for move in solve_phase(phase, state) do
            state = apply(move, state)
            moves.add(move)
        od
    od

    assert key(4, state) =~ key(4, solved)

    write_line(title)
    write_line("solved in {moves.count} moves:")
    write_line(moves |> take(20) |> map(notation) |> join(" "))
    write_line(moves |> skip(20) |> map(notation) |> join(" "))
    write_line("")
si

let cubies =
    "UL DL RF UB FD BR DB UF DR UR BL FL FDR BLU DLB URB RUF FLD BRD FUL"

solve(cubies, parse(cubies))

let scramble = [0, 14, 7, 12, 5, 9, 1, 16, 3, 11]

solve(
    "scrambled by {scramble |> map(notation) |> join(" ")}",
    scramble |> reduce(solved, (state, move) => apply(move, state)))
